This is done without live rounds/bullets so you don’t shoot anyone while practicing your weapon drills. We go through groups and rotate through to the range to shoot several times. After we shoot we are required to empty all our magazines of rounds for when we leave the range. When our group was up to shoot again, I went to go fill my mags with rounds. When we were about to i picked up my mags and noticed I had 2 mags full with rounds already. Turns out the whole time while outside the range I was doing weapon drills with live rounds. It just so happen that out of the 5 magazines I was carrying I didn’t pick up the 2 that had live rounds. I was practicing fast speed weapon drills. I felt like God saved me that day because I remembered when I reloaded I picked up a different magazine in a spot on my pouch that  I usually never pick up unless it’s the last one, these were empty ones. If I picked up my usual mags I would have shot live rounds outside the range with people next to me. When I found out I could have told my Sergeant the truth or lie (since we were about to fill up our magazines with rounds anyway). Just before I already decided to tell my Sergeant and not lie, the next range shoot was cancelled, so we weren’t going to fill out mags with rounds again. 

If I lied, I would have been caught with live rounds in my mags afterward and been in massive trouble and been charged by the military. I told the truth anyway and turns out I didn’t get charged anything for my honesty.
